backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for the StudentSathi backend, defining data types and CRUD operations for feature requests, user profiles, announcements, assignments, study tasks, and conversation history, with role-based access control and blob storage mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping implemented feature IDs (Leave Application page button behaviors, date picker fixes, etc.) to their affected files, components, and test IDs with confidence ratings.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Auto-generated text file containing one-line summaries of each frontend source file, serving as a quick reference index for the frontend codebase structure.
frontend/.release/production-version.txt: Single-value file containing the current production draft version number (73) used by the CI/CD system to determine which build to promote to the live channel.
frontend/.release/README.md: Documents the CI/CD production version promotion system, explaining how updating production-version.txt triggers a draft-to-production channel promotion without rebuilding source code.
frontend/index.css: Root Tailwind CSS entry point defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for the full design token system (colors, borders, charts, sidebar) in both light and dark modes.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML shell for the StudentSathi React SPA, setting the page title and mounting the app via the /src/main.tsx module entry point.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that configures TanStack Router with all application routes (home, assignment, study planner, notes cleaner, leave application, resume builder, request feature), wraps the app in ThemeProvider, and renders the global Toaster.
frontend/src/components/AssignmentChatbo: Floating chatbot component for the Assignment Format page supporting multi-language UI, voice input/output, image upload via Tesseract OCR, and AI-assisted assignment content generation with PDF/Word/text download options.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Defines the main app layout with a sticky header containing desktop and mobile navigation links, an Outlet for page content, and a footer with attribution.
frontend/src/components/primitives/Butto: A reusable Button primitive with configurable variant and size styles, supporting an asChild prop to clone styles onto a child element.
Exports composable Card layout primitives (Card, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription, CardContent, CardFooter) with Tailwind-based styling.
frontend/src/components/primitives/Sheet: A custom slide-in Sheet/drawer component with context-based open state, supporting left/right/top/bottom sides, a trigger, and an overlay backdrop.
frontend/src/components/primitives/Toast: A placeholder Toaster component that renders nothing, intended as a stub for a future toast notification implementation.
frontend/src/components/StudentSathiAssi: A chat assistant component supporting text, voice (speech recognition), and image (OCR via Tesseract.js) input, with assignment generation and confirmation flows using React Query mutations.
frontend/src/components/studyPlanner/Dai: A markdown note indicating that DailyProgressChart.tsx is working correctly and must not be modified as part of the weekly chart fix.
Renders a donut SVG chart and stats grid showing daily study task completion, pending counts, and total study time.
frontend/src/components/studyPlanner/Pro: Conditionally renders either the DailyProgressChart or WeeklyProgressChart based on the viewType prop, wrapped in a labeled section.
frontend/src/components/studyPlanner/Sub: Renders a small colored badge for a subject name, deriving the color class from a utility function based on subject name or an optional color override.
A searchable popover dropdown component for filtering study planner tasks by subject, showing task counts per subject and supporting selection/deselection.
frontend/src/components/studyPlanner/Wee: A card component that displays weekly study task progress as an SVG donut chart with stats for completed, pending, and total study time.
frontend/src/components/UserGuidelineDoc: Empty file with no content or exports.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: A hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous ICP backend actor using React Query, invalidating dependent queries whenever the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity authentication context and hook, managing AuthClient creation, login/logout flow, and identity persistence across page reloads.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query mutations and queries for backend interactions including feature requests, assignment generation, conversation saving, and study planner task management.
frontend/src/hooks/useStudyPlannerSort.t: A hook that persists and restores the study planner sort mode ('default' or 'dateTime') in localStorage across sessions.
frontend/src/hooks/useStudyPlannerSubjec: A hook that independently persists and restores subject filter selections for the daily and weekly study planner views using localStorage.
frontend/src/hooks/useStudyPlannerView.t: A hook that persists and restores the study planner view mode ('daily' or 'weekly') in localStorage, defaulting to 'weekly'.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that sets up Tailwind directives and defines CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens (backgrounds, foregrounds, primary, sidebar, chart colors, etc.).
frontend/src/main.tsx: React app entry point that mounts the app with QueryClientProvider for React Query and InternetIdentityProvider for authentication context.
A feature-rich page for creating and formatting academic assignments, supporting multilingual UI, title page fields, font/spacing settings, an editor with AI improvement, and PDF/Word/text download options.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: The landing page displaying a hero section and a grid of six tool cards (Assignment Format, Study Planner, Notes Cleaner, Leave Application, Resume Builder, Request a Feature) with navigation links.
A form-based page for generating student leave application letters, supporting multiple languages, recipient types, date ranges, leave reasons, and PDF download/copy functionality.
frontend/src/pages/NotesCleanerPage.tsx: A two-panel page where users paste rough notes and receive cleaned, formatted output with options for bullet conversion, definition style, and auto-detected headings, plus copy and TXT download actions.
frontend/src/pages/RequestFeaturePage.ts: A simple form page that lets students submit feature requests (with an optional email) via a mutation hook, displaying success/error toasts on submission.
frontend/src/pages/ResumeBuilderPage.tsx: A React page component that provides a form-based resume builder for students and freshers, allowing input of personal info, education, skills, and projects, then generates and copies a plain-text formatted resume.
frontend/src/pages/StudyPlannerPage.tsx: A React page component for a study planner that supports adding, toggling, and deleting tasks with subject, priority, date, and duration fields, with both authenticated (ICP backend) and guest (local storage) modes, plus sorting, filtering, and PDF/TXT export.
frontend/src/utils/leaveApplicationDateF: Utility functions for formatting single dates, date ranges, and leave durations into human-readable strings, and calculating the number of days between two dates.
frontend/src/utils/leaveApplicationLette: Defines translation records and letter-generation logic for leave application letters across 20+ languages, supporting multiple recipient types, duration types, and localized date formatting.
frontend/src/utils/leaveApplicationPdfEx: Opens a new browser window with a print-ready HTML page containing the leave application letter, applying language-appropriate fonts and RTL/LTR direction, then triggers the browser print dialog for PDF saving.
frontend/src/utils/leaveApplicationReaso: Defines the set of predefined leave reason options (sick, family, personal, emergency, other) with their display labels and template sentences, plus a helper to retrieve the appropriate reason sentence.
frontend/src/utils/notesCleanerBulletSty: Defines bullet style types and provides helper functions to get the bullet prefix string and current locked bullet style, currently fixed to dash ('- ') for Module 01.
frontend/src/utils/notesCleanerFormat.ts: Provides text transformation utilities for the Notes Cleaner feature, including auto-detecting headings, applying definition-style formatting, and splitting text into sentences per line.
frontend/src/utils/notesCleanerTxtDownlo: Provides a `downloadNotesAsTxt` function that generates a filename (from a custom name or the first word of the content plus date) and triggers a browser download of cleaned notes as a plain text file.
Exports `parseDurationToMinutes` and `formatMinutesToDuration` to convert between duration strings (e.g., '1.5 hours', '30 minutes') and numeric minute values.
frontend/src/utils/studyPlannerGuestStor: Manages guest-mode Study Planner tasks in localStorage, exposing CRUD functions (`loadGuestTasks`, `addGuestTask`, `toggleGuestTaskCompletion`, `deleteGuestTask`, `clearAllGuestTasks`) and the `GuestStudyTask` interface.
frontend/src/utils/studyPlannerPdfExport: Exports `exportTasksToPdf` which generates a formatted HTML document from study tasks and opens it in a new window to trigger the browser's print-to-PDF dialog.
frontend/src/utils/studyPlannerSort.ts: Provides deterministic sorting utilities for study tasks, supporting `default` (by task ID) and `dateTime` (chronological, tasks without dates last) sort modes via the `sortTasks` function.
frontend/src/utils/studyPlannerTaskDateT: Utility functions for converting HTML date/time input strings to backend/guest formats (`dateInputToTimestamp`, `timeInputToOptionalTime`) and formatting task date-time values for display (`formatTaskDateTime`).
frontend/src/utils/studyPlannerTxtExport: Exports `exportTasksToTxt` which formats study tasks into a plain-text document with a header, summary counts, and task details, then triggers a browser download as a `.txt` file.
frontend/src/utils/studyPlannerWeek.ts: Provides date utilities for the weekly Study Planner view, including normalizing bigint/number task dates, computing the current week's Monday–Sunday bounds, and checking or indexing a date within the current week.
frontend/src/utils/subjectColorMapping.t: Provides a centralized mapping of subject names to color names and exports utility functions to retrieve Tailwind CSS badge and indicator bar color classes for a given subject, with optional persisted color override.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routes, with helpers for persisting values to/from sessionStorage and cleaning sensitive params from the URL bar.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration that sets up dark mode, custom OKLCH-based design tokens (colors, border radius, shadows), accordion keyframe animations, and registers the typography, container-queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Tracks the current project state (version 3) for an Application Generator Tool, documenting completed features around manual generation mode, always-visible output buttons, Clear Output functionality, date picker fix, and RTL language support.
unknown.txt: A feature specification document describing the Assignment Format page's editable fields, download options, AI improvement button, subject heading panel, citation helper, teacher checklist, and the embedded 'Student Sathi Assistant' chatbot with its UI behavior and Urdu-language interaction rules.
